generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-2022 to 2025-2026) achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction/maintenance works only) of Rs.2.34 Crores

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-2022 to 2025-2026) Satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one Water Supply Project / Under Ground Drainage Project including Operation & Maintenance or Operation and maintenance of Water Supply scheme / Under Ground Drainage scheme of value not less than Rs.1.76 Crores Note: The value of work mentioned in the workdone certificate shall be including GST

Executed or maintained any water supply scheme / Under Ground Drainage scheme in any one year (i.e. from 2021-22 to 205-26) consisting of RCC/UPVC/DWC/ DI/ MS/HDPE/CI/PSC/PVC/Stone Ware or in combination of minimum 77 Km, 1 No. of STP/WTP of capacity 4.0MLD. Pumping machinery of Minimum Capacity 30 HP
Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.39.00 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement)

It is mandatory to upload the various Technical & Financial eligibility requirements and also fill up the formats mentioned in various Sections of Bid Document while submitting the bids. The incomplete bids shall be considered as substantially non responsive
Right to accept any tender and to reject any or all the tenders rests with the Chief Engineer, K.U.W.S and D. Board, Dharwad
Any other relevant document as per bid documents

itemList.description: Establishment cost, Quality control, Communication, transportation & office maintenance during O&M period  essential for successful routine maintenance of UGD system etc complete as directed by Engineer-in-charge. (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7 Specifications for all the items) for 1st year

Providing, supplying, installing and commissioning office equipment required for setting up site office for operation and maintenance works, including computers, printers, UPS, furniture, internet connectivity, stationery and all allied accessories, etc complete as per tender specifications etc complete  as directed by Engineer-in-Charge (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7 Specifications for all the items)

Providing, supplying and maintaining adequate stock of chemicals and consumables for uninterrupted operation of 7 Nos. Wetwells, 8 MLD SBR type STP and 0.50 MLD Phytorid type STP, including all materials required to meet treated effluent discharge norms, etc complete in all respects for successful O&M of UGD system as per tender conditions  etc complete as directed by Engineer-in-Charge (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7 Specifications for all the items) for 1st year

Providing comprehensive maintenance and repair services for all the components under the Underground Drainage (UGD) system, including inspection, cleaning, desilting, replacement of damaged components, attending leakages and emergency works, emergency complaint attending, blockage clearance and restoration of sewer lines and manholes components,HSC's, rising main, pumping stations, Sewage treatment plants complete for the contract period as per O&M requirements etc complete as directed by the  Engineer-in-Charge(Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7 Specifications for all the items) for 1st year
